CommunityApplications.Profile:
**Fiefdom** is an isometric castle-builder in the spirit of Stronghold Crusader, played in the browser. Raise a settlement in the desert, feed it, and hold it against a rival lord who has to build his economy under exactly the same rules you do.
**Highlights** - Full production chains: timber, stone, iron and pitch; wheat to flour to bread; hops to ale and the inn; pigs and hunted game to meat. - Painted stockpile and granary yards whose squares show what is actually stored on them, and fill up if you do not expand. - Curtain walls, gatehouses and towers you can post archers on for extra reach — and where melee cannot touch them. - Siege engines that are the only thing able to break stone, and pitch marshes you can trench, then set alight under an advancing column. - An enemy lord who builds a woodcutter before a barracks, starves if he over-houses, and can be beaten by knocking down his keep. - Six maps of different character, from a wooded valley with no opposition to bare rock with a lord next door.
**Nothing to configure.** No database, no API keys, no accounts — set a port, start it, open the WebUI.
⚠ **Saved games live in your browser**, not on the server. They do not follow you between devices or browsers, and clearing site data removes them. This is also why the container needs no volume.
Runs entirely client-side, so the container is just nginx serving files and sits near zero CPU. A WebGL-capable browser is required.
Every sprite in the game is procedurally generated in Blender — nothing is taken from an asset pack.
📖 Install guide: https://github.com/halvar20000/fiefdom/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md
Issues and support: https://github.com/halvar20000/fiefdom/issues
